dialogues.speaker: Nusta
dialogues.text: Great hero, it is an honor to be able to work for you.

choices.text: I feel like we've met before...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: That's right! I was fortunate enough to fight against the Abyss alongside you. When the dust settled, we even took a picture together in front of the Stadium of the Sacred Flame!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I never imagined I'd run into you here in Fontaine.

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If I'd have known, I wouldn't have tried all those drinks for the first time over at The Rusty Rudder. Standing here in front of you tipsy like this, it's a little bit embarrassing...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Ahem, but don't worry, it's mostly worn off already. I'm in complete control of the situation!

choices.text: How are you finding the work here?

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: I love it! Working at a film-themed amusement park is the sort of unique life experience you don't often get the chance to enjoy...

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: If I hadn't gone and made the stupid mistake of drinking and diving — and losing my wallet in the process — then I'm sure I'd be having even more fun!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: But even though every last Mora of my travel expenses was in that wallet, it's not the end of the world... You pay decent wages here, so if I work hard enough, I'm sure I'll be able to make it all back in just a few days!

response.speaker: Nusta
response.text: Of course! This adventure attraction is a lot of fun, and there's no better motivation to work hard than doing something that stimulates you!
